convention: Ordinary Latin reading with ASCII apostrophe for both ayn and hamza; not scholarly transliteration. Retain macrons/emphatic Latin letters; native no-IPA guard unchanged.

rows.tradeoff: Simplified apostrophe represents both ayn and hamza; preserves an articulation marker but loses their typographic distinction. Not an exact academic transliteration.
